brief:
The owner of Gillette Stadium has removed Macklemore from upcoming Ed Sheeran tour dates at the venue, citing concerns over the rapper's rhetoric regarding Palestine, Al Jazeera English reported. The decision comes after Macklemore has been vocal in his support for Palestinian causes.

No further details were provided regarding the specific statements that prompted the action or the scope of performances affected.
dek: Gillette Stadium owner cites concerns over Macklemore's rhetoric as reason for barring him from performances.
title: Gillette Stadium owner bars Macklemore from Ed Sheeran tour over Palestine advocacy
